name: Play-Action TE Throwback Leak (Counter Shell PA)
formation: 11P Gun Trips Left vs Nickel Under

summary.motive: Use counter run look PA to move WILL linebacker inside, then throw back to leaking TE in the vacated flat.
summary.whyItWorks: Counter action freezes all three second-level defenders simultaneously — WILL triggers inside, MIKE bites on H drag, SS over-triggers on QB boot — leaving the TE's flat completely unoccupied.
summary.failureMode: A disciplined WILL linebacker who ignores the PA fake and stays in flat zone coverage, or an SS who does not overcommit to the QB bootleg.

beats.title: 1. Counter PA Freeze
beats.text: The QB's reverse pivot and RB's counter false step perfectly mimic the counter trey run. Both linebackers freeze for a full second, allowing the TE to quietly leak backside underneath coverage.

beats.title: 2. TE Throwback Release
beats.text: After selling a run block for 0.8 seconds, the TE slips off his block and leaks backside into the flat. The WILL linebacker is already committed inside, leaving the TE unguarded.

beats.title: 3. The Void in the Flat
beats.text: As the QB boots weakside and the H drag draws the Nickel and MIKE linebackers across the field, the boundary flat opens completely. The TE runs freely behind the vacated WILL zone.

beats.title: 4. Big Gain on Throwback
beats.text: The SS over-triggers on the QB boot and cannot recover to the TE in time. Johnson's design creates a 15+ yard gain from an 11-personnel counter shell — the defense never anticipated the throwback.

relations.tell: Same counter step from RB and reverse pivot from QB — but TE releases instead of blocking at 0.8s.
